quote_zh: Herstellung der metastabilen Kristallmodifikation III ... Das Kristallisat wird abfiltriert und bei Temperaturen < 60°C getrocknet.
notes: The product is named only by the heading; the body refers to it as das Kristallisat. No mass, no yield and no purity is given for it anywhere in the section, and that absence is a finding in its own right: this patent reports no quantitative outcome for any of its three preparations. The product is the same molecule as the reactant, differing only in crystal form, so two records of this section deliberately name one substance. Alias correction: this section prints the modification's name only as "metastabilen Kristallmodifikation III" at line 670, so no canonical alias is carried on this record.
No volume is stated for the solvent.
